title: Jupiter reselects inherited nested tests by unique ID
summary: Class selection now executed the two distinct bodies once. Separate public Launcher requests using the saved unique IDs reran exactly their respective declaring classes.

change.description: Jupiter distinguishes a nested test declared in a superclass from one with the same simple name declared in the selected subclass.

notes: Each deployment checks the JDK fingerprint, ordered artifact digests, caller classes and original class providers. The same compiled caller runs both sides in fresh JVMs.
